latest.text: Hi @RiskyReps, All of those issues should now be completely resolved in the new v0.9.7 release! Please rest assured regarding your downloaded models: they are NOT stored inside the application directory (/data/homebrew/PPSA99699). Instead, all models, LoRAs, and presets are stored independently in /data/MacheteAI (and /data/PS5SD).
